title: Recycling Tycoon: Bottle Route
shortDescription: Empty deposit machines, plan truck routes and bale the bottles. Run the network.
fullDescription:
The town has just switched on its bottle deposit scheme and everyone is bringing their bottles back at once. Machines outside the corner shops are filling up, a café is calling about its bags and the count line at the depot is backing up. You hold the collection contract. Keep the bottles moving.

Bottle Route is a recycling tycoon about running a deposit-return network. Empty the machines before they overflow, plan truck routes that do not waste fuel, count the returns at the depot, press the plastic, cans and glass into bales and sell them at the right moment.

EMPTY THE MACHINES
- Every machine has a fill bar. Let one overflow and people walk home with their bottles and your Green Rating drops.
- Tap machines to build a route, send the van and watch its load bar fill up stop by stop.
- Set a service rule for each machine: empty at 60 %, 80 % or 95 %, every day, or only when you send a truck.
- Use the Suggest button, or build the dispatch office and let it plan routes from your rules.

PLAN SMART ROUTES
- Every kilometre costs fuel. Empty too rarely and machines overflow, empty too often and half-empty trucks burn money.
- Vans for the main roads, cargo bikes for the narrow lanes of Old Town, compactor trucks that squeeze plastic for long rings.
- Add fill sensors to see real numbers instead of estimates.

RUN THE DEPOT
- The count line earns a handling fee for every bottle. Add lines when the queue gets long.
- The baler presses plastic, cans and glass into bales. Stack them in the yard.
- Bale prices change every day. Sell when the price is good or keep bales for later.

HANDLE THE CHAOS
10 kinds of events keep every day different: a heat wave fills machines 60 % faster, match day floods the stadium machines in two hours, a bottle gets stuck, a sensor says there is room when there is none, someone brings hundreds of bottles at once, a truck breaks down, fuel gets more expensive, a bale price falls, the baler stops and a glass load breaks. Events are short and never end your game.

GROW THE NETWORK
- Start with three machines in the Harbour Quarter, then open Old Town, University Hill and the Stadium & Fairground.
- Sign up shops as return points and pick up bags from cafés and hotels.
- 21 research projects: sensors, compactors, route optimiser, fuel saver, faster counting, a faster baler, an evening shift and more.
- Hire drivers and technicians, buy bigger bins and new machines.
- Earn up to three stars a day for service, efficiency and depot flow. Stars raise your Green Rating and open new districts.
- While you are away, your network keeps working and a welcome-back card shows what it earned.

A LIVING TOWN
Citizens walk to the machines with their bags, trucks drive the streets and bales stack up in the yard. A step-by-step guide shows each action the first time. Choose Low, Medium or High graphics to suit your phone.

GOOD TO KNOW
- Single-player. No account and no sign-in. Your network is saved on your device.
- The game contains ads and optional in-app purchases: one-time upgrades, looks for your trucks, machines and depot, and coin packs. Nothing is needed to finish the game.
- Ads show our other games in a banner and between days. Remove Ads, the Chief Operator Edition, the Network Pass and the Complete Bottle Route remove them. Other purchases do not remove ads.
- Reward videos are always optional. With ad removal you get the same capped rewards without a video.
- Coin packs are used up and are not restored on a new device.
- Ten languages: English, Turkish, German, Spanish, French, Portuguese, Russian, Japanese, Korean and Hindi.

If you like recycling games, garbage truck games and logistics tycoons, take the contract and keep the town's bottles moving.
